svg.title: Two clocks start at once, and neither waits
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Two clocks start at once, and neither waits” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A thirty-second timeline with two swimlanes that both begin when a pod is marked for deletion: above it the process runs a preStop hook for five seconds, drains for two and exits at seven, with SIGKILL waiting at thirty; below it the EndpointSlice controller removes the pod at 0.1 seconds and kube-proxy on three nodes catches up at 0.9, 1.2 and 3.4 seconds. A red dashed line at 0.3 seconds marks where a naive process exits, losing 187 requests, and a green dashed line at seven seconds loses none of 22,500.
